sort_request.text: My toilet keeps running. What should I look at first?

request.text: My toilet keeps running. What should I look at first?

answer.short: A running toilet comes from the water level, the flapper, its chain or the fill valve. The first three take about fifteen minutes and no tools.

known.text: Take the lid off the tank and flush once so you can watch.
1. Water spills into the tall tube: the water level is set too high. Turn the screw on the fill valve, or slide the float down, until the water stops about an inch below the top of the tube.

sort_request.text: Can my landlord keep my deposit for carpet wear?

price.formula: Sort 40 · slip 60 · 3 sources 360 · about 300 words 300 · check 80

request.text: Can my landlord keep my deposit for carpet wear?

answer.short: Usually no. Oregon law bars deductions for ordinary wear and tear. A landlord who keeps a deposit wrongly can owe twice the amount.

known.text: A landlord can deduct for damage beyond normal use, such as stains, burns, tears or pet damage. Carpet worn thin from walking counts as normal use.
Carpet cleaning can be charged when two things are true: the landlord machine cleaned the carpet before you moved in, and your written lease says cleaning is charged in every case.

changes_if: Your lease charges for carpet cleaning in every case.
The carpet has stains, burns or tears.

desks.what: Statewide renters' rights hotline
desks.ask: Does carpet wear count as normal use?

desks.what: Where deposit disputes usually end up if a letter does not work.

desks.cost: A filing fee, listed on your county court website
desks.bring: The lease, photos and any letters

answer.ask_someone: Do you know anyone who has disputed a deposit? Ask them what they sent and what happened.

question_back.text: Did you get a written list of deductions?

choices.label: Yes
choices.next: Compare each deduction to the rules above. For any that look like normal wear, send the landlord a short letter asking for that amount back within 10 days. Keep a copy.

choices.label: No
choices.next: Write to the landlord asking for the full deposit, and say no written list arrived within 31 days. The tenants hotline can check your letter.

choices.label: Not sure
choices.next: Check your mail and email from the landlord since move out. The list has to be in writing.

sort_request.text: Can I take ibuprofen with my blood pressure medicine?

price.formula: Sort 40 · slip 60 · 3 sources 360 · about 300 words 300 · check 80

request.text: Can I take ibuprofen with my blood pressure medicine?

answer.short: Ask the pharmacist before you take it. Ibuprofen can raise blood pressure a few points and can work against some blood pressure medicines.

known.text: In studies, regular ibuprofen raised the top blood pressure number by about 3 to 4 points. For a single dose that change is usually small. Some experts still advise people with high blood pressure to avoid this group of pain relievers, called NSAIDs, which also includes naproxen.
A pharmacist can check your exact medicine and suggest a pain reliever that fits it.

changes_if: You need it for more than a few days.
You also have kidney or heart problems.

desks.name: The pharmacist at any drugstore counter
desks.what: Checks your exact medicine against the pain reliever.
desks.ask: Does ibuprofen fit my blood pressure medicine?
desks.bring: The name and dose of your blood pressure medicine. A photo of the bottle works.

desks.name: Your clinic's nurse line
desks.what: If your clinic has one, the number is often on your last visit summary.
desks.ask: Which pain reliever fits my medicine?

question_back.text: Is this for one headache or for several days?

choices.label: One headache
choices.next: A quick question at the pharmacy counter covers it. Ask whether acetaminophen or another pain reliever suits your medicine.

choices.label: Several days
choices.next: Several days of headaches is worth a call to your clinic as well as the pharmacist. Ongoing headaches can be connected to blood pressure.

sort_request.text: Should I open a bubble tea shop at this location?

price.formula: Sort 40 · slip 60 · 3 sources 360 · about 300 words 300 · check 80

request.text: Should I open a bubble tea shop at this location?

answer.short: It depends on three numbers you can find this month: the rent, what each drink earns after costs, and how many drinks you can sell in a day.

known.text: The block has to buy enough drinks every day to cover the rent, the staff and you.
Divide the monthly rent by what one drink earns after ingredients, cups and wages, then by 30. The result is the drinks a day that pay the rent.

changes_if: There is already a tea or coffee shop within a few blocks.
The lease runs five years or more and you sign it personally.
